title: Software Application Cache and Credential Vault Reset

purpose.text: Automated workflow to diagnose and resolve application launch hangs, corrupted local cache locks, and frozen credential states on Windows endpoints by terminating processes, clearing cache, and restarting services.
purpose.quote: Automated workflow to diagnose and resolve application launch hangs, corrupted local cache locks, an

scope.text: Applies to software operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to software operations and authorized agents.

roles.responsibility: Executes Software Application Cache and Credential Vault Reset

steps.action: Verify endpoint network connectivity before performing remote diagnostics.
steps.expected_outcome: If ping replies are received, set variables.endpoint_reachable = true, else set variables.endpoint_reachable = false
steps.quote: Verify endpoint network connectivity before performing remote diagnostics.

steps.action: Inspect target application process status to determine if it is running or hung.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains process information, set variables.process_running = true, else set variables.process_running = false
steps.quote: Inspect target application process status to determine if it is running or hung.

steps.action: Forcibly terminate hanging application process to release file locks.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.process_terminated = true, else set variables.process_terminated = false
steps.quote: Forcibly terminate hanging application process to release file locks.

steps.action: Clear corrupted application cache and temp store from local user directory.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.cache_cleared = true, else set variables.cache_cleared = false
steps.quote: Clear corrupted application cache and temp store from local user directory.

steps.action: Restart application background service to re-initialize configuration.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.service_restarted = true, else set variables.service_restarted = false
steps.quote: Restart application background service to re-initialize configuration.

steps.action: Verify service operational status after restart.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Running', set variables.service_operational = true, else set variables.service_operational = false
steps.quote: Verify service operational status after restart.
